items.text: Search settings — Ctrl+Shift+K / Cmd+Shift+K in the breadcrumb bar finds tabs, General panels (including Advanced while on Essentials), stats sections, colors groups, keyboard bindings, and Help blocks.
Quick actions palette — Ctrl+K / Cmd+K runs save, open dashboard, and tour resets only — settings navigation lives in search.
Search index stays fresh — rebuilds after tab opens, layer switches, language changes, and bookmark list renders.
Layout version — choose Classic (original look) or Modern (refreshed visuals, same structure). Themes still control all colors.
Switch anytime — Config → General → Layout → Layout version, or command mode :layoutversion modern / :layoutversion classic / :layoutversion toggle on the dashboard.
Onboarding preview — first-run wizard includes a layout step with a live preview while you choose.
Layout tip — classic users who skip modern in onboarding may see a one-time spotlight after What's new; try it or keep classic — switch later in config anytime.
Shorter onboarding — keyboard and mouse bookmark tips merged into one step; the finish step covers pages and first bookmarks (no separate post-setup wizard).
Chained prompts — after onboarding, What's new and (classic layout) a layout tip may appear one after another in the same session. Skip for later defers the rest until next session.
Cleanup — removed dead post-setup wizard, tour spotlight, and recent-bookmarks spotlight code.
Status essentials — compact monitoring overview under Essentials (monitored count + toggle); full tuning stays in Advanced.
Health link — opens from the Essentials status summary when the Health dashboard is enabled.
